work: Troelstra, A. S., 'Metamathematical Investigation of Intuitionistic Arithmetic and Analysis', Lecture Notes in Mathematics 344 (1973)
required_version: 1973 publication identified by the complete canonical record
required_extent: whole-book selection: The selected System T/functional-interpretation presentation for intuitionistic arithmetic, with complete realization of every logical and induction rule and precise auxiliary principles.

files.version: ILLC Prepublication Series X-93-05 (Technical Notes X-1993-05): 'Metamathematical Investigation of Intuitionistic Arithmetic and Analysis, second, corrected edition', A.S. Troelstra (editor), received June 1993; image-only scan (Adobe PDF Library 7.0, 2010), no text layer
files.extent_note: Page-number audit of all 511 physical pages: ILLC cover, series list, title/copyright, Preface to the second edition (III), Preface to the first edition IV-VI, Table of contents VII-XV, then printed pp.1-485 in continuous order (unnumbered chapter-opening pages fall in their expected slots, e.g. 1, 97, 175, 275, 324, 392, 454, 462, 476), then 'Corrections and Additions' pp.486-491, then ILLC series list. Whole book present including the System T / functional-interpretation material (Ch. III per TOC).
files.version_differs: Not the 1973 Springer LNM 344 printing. Per the 1993 preface: the original 1973 typescript is the basis; small corrections were made by hand in the text, more substantial changes inserted or marked in the margin, with a new 'Corrections and Additions' list (pp.486-491) and a new preface. Copyright page: 'The first edition appeared in 1973 with Springer-Verlag, Berlin (ISBN 3-540-06491-5) and Springer-Verlag New York (ISBN 0-387-06491-5)'. Pagination 1-485 appears to follow the typescript; textual identity with LNM 344 is not verified.
